observations: Truck-mounted borehole drilling rig with an orange lattice mast mounted on a white truck.
The truck is a Nissan Diesel, identified by the 'UD' logo and 'NISSAN DIESEL' text on the grille in photo 1.
The drilling mast is currently in the horizontal transport position.
A rack on the left side of the truck holds several drill pipes.
The equipment shows significant surface wear, dust, and some rust on the mast structure.
The photos are limited to the front and left side of the vehicle; the rear, right side, and operator controls are not visible.
The truck has a Nigerian license plate visible in photo 1.
